title: RBI finalises acquisition finance norms; caps overseas syndicated deal exposure at 20%
theme: RBI finalises acquisition finance norms; caps overseas syndicated deal exposure at 20%
attentionJustification: Enforceable regulatory circular issued by RBI/SEBI/DICGC.

constituentArticles.title: RBI finalises acquisition finance norms; caps overseas syndicated deal exposure at 20%
constituentArticles.text: RBI finalised acquisition financing framework: bank participation capped at 20% (up from 10%), total financing max 75% of acquisition value, debt-equity max 3:1, minimum net worth ₹500 Cr, effective April 1, 2026.
